name: JD Printer
author: Joerg Dommermuth

provenance.note: The earliest Prt build held. 2,536 bytes, 58 keywords, against 3,580 bytes and 63 keywords for 1.3. The AMOS PD Library CD carries the same file under files/Aminet/JDLIB4_6.extracted/, byte-identical, so that is a mirror of this upload rather than a second source. The uploader's readme is Michael Cox rather than the author; it says the documentation is German and describes the archive as a whole, not this library.
provenance.redistribution: Third-party extension, redistribution terms unverified. Uploaded to Aminet, whose upload terms require the submitter to state distribution conditions; none is stated for this library specifically. Kept as a fixture for identification and reference only.

notes: EVERY KEYWORD IS SPELLED DIFFERENTLY FROM 1.3. This build names them `Prt Reset`, `Prt Bold`, `Prt Under`; 1.3 and 1.4 name the same routines `Jd Prt Reset`, `Jd Prt Bold`, `Jd Prt Under`. The two tables share not one keyword name, so a port written against either answers nothing for the other -- which is what src/runtime/extimpl.ts `aliases` exists to fix, and this is its live case. Do not read the `V1.1` header on prt.s in the jd-prt-1.3 fixture as evidence about this build: that source declares 63 prefixed keywords and is 1.3's, carrying a version comment its author never bumped. The binary settles it, as it does for LDos's crypt routines and TURBO's plane check.
